title: •K’lor’slug
caption: •K’lor’slug (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. If your character in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Non-Jedi, non-{warrior} characters may not have their deploy cost modified by Bad Feeling Have I. {alter}
lore: *Dejarik* of venomous swamp creature from Noe’ha’on. Keen senses of smell and vision. Dangerous hunter. Lays eggs – hundreds of ravenously hungry hatchlings.
